attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 7.9), installed Podman, created the unprivileged user appsvc, and configured a rootless container (nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:alpine) running on port 8080 under that account. The container starts at boot via a systemd system unit (webapp-container.service, User=appsvc) that requires no active login session for appsvc - only lingering is enabled, no logind session exists. Verified across a full node restart: new boot ID, container auto-started, and HTTP 200 served on port 8080, all with zero login sessions for appsvc.
